mapper.select: SELECT id FROM t_agent_definition WHERE id=#{id} AND del_flag=0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT a.*, COALESCE(p.version,0) active_version, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_agent_run r WHERE r.agent_id=a.id AND r.del_flag=0) call_count FROM t_agent_definition a LEFT JOIN t_agent_release p ON p.id=a.active_release_id AND p.del_flag=0 WHERE a.del_flag=0 AND a.id=#{id} AND a.code=#{code} ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1000
